subject: Pricing call recap + marketplace private-offer unit price mapping
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@clearmetrics.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearmetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing call — private offers & unit economics for Clearmetrics

Alex / team — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + a concrete price-mapping draft so your procurement team has something to validate against. Please call out any corrections.

Summary of what we heard on the call:
- Expected steady-state token volume: 1.0–1.5B tokens/month (peaks ~2B).
- Target monthly budget range: $15k–$30k/month (scale over next 6–12 months).
- Preference to purchase through marketplace private offers (AWS preferred, evaluating GCP and Azure).
- Need a line-item unit price to include on PO (we agreed to share $/1M tokens numbers).

High-level unit-econ targets (for discussion):
- Target that hits their budget envelope: ~ $8–$12 per 1M tokens (combined request+response) depending on model and marketplace fees.

Draft unit price mapping (examples):
- Redwood hosted list price (reference model: rw-gen-large): $9.00 / 1M tokens
- AWS Private Offer (assume 10% marketplace uplift + transaction fees): $9.90 / 1M tokens
- GCP Marketplace (assume ~12% uplift): $10.08 / 1M tokens
- Azure Marketplace (assume ~15% uplift): $10.35 / 1M tokens

Notes and assumptions:
- Above numbers are illustrative and assume a private-offer rebate structure that preserves per-token economics while accounting for marketplace margin.
- If you want a deeper unit-econ table by model (gen vs chat, quantized variants), we can attach a CSV. See attached Clearmetrics-MAPL-v1.xlsx for a per-model breakdown.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirms preferred marketplace (AWS / GCP / Azure).
2) If AWS, procurement shares any required PO template/fields (we can ingest and return a filled private-offer request).
3) We draft formal private-offer PRICING spreadsheet + DocuSign SOW for signature.
4) If acceptable, we convert the target monthly volume and $/1M token into a committed spend (reserved capacity) proposal to lower unit price further.

Attachments: Clearmetrics-MAPL-v1.xlsx (per-model volume sensitivity), redwood-marketplace-po-mapping.csv (compact mapping)

Thanks — happy to hop on a follow-up with procurement.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@clearmetrics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearmetrics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing call — private offers & unit economics for Clearmetrics

Sofia — this is very helpful, thanks. A couple clarifications from procurement:

- Budget and volumes: the $15k–$30k/month is our current expectation for Q3; if we commit to reserved capacity we could move to the high end of that range or slightly above. 1.2B tokens/month is the most likely starting point.
- Marketplace choice: AWS first (we prefer consolidating on one marketplace) but we need the PO to show exact unit price and billing account info.
- Marketplace uplifts: procurement flagged that AWS private offers sometimes include a 5–12% margin depending on channel — your 10% assumption is acceptable as a starting point, but will need an explicitly stated seller margin on any private-offer paperwork.

Attached is our PO template (CM-PO-Template.pdf) — can you confirm which fields you need filled? Also need a preliminary line item we can circulate internally: final $/1M token for the model variant we'll use in production (we're leaning toward the rw-chat-advanced equivalent).

If you can send a single-line unit price (finalized for AWS PO) and an expected monthly spend table for 1.0 / 1.2 / 1.5B tokens, that will speed internal approvals.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | Clearmetrics Inc.
alex.chen@clearmetrics.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@clearmetrics.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearmetrics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing call — private offers & unit economics for Clearmetrics

Alex — thanks for the fast reply and the PO template. Per your asks, below is a compact single-line unit price for the rw-chat-advanced family and a short table for the monthly spend scenarios. These are the numbers we'd populate into the AWS private-offer request; we'll flag the explicit marketplace uplift percentage on the paperwork.

Single-line unit price (rw-chat-advanced, combined request+response tokens):
- Redwood hosted list price: $11.00 / 1M tokens
- AWS Private Offer (10% uplift example): $12.10 / 1M tokens

Monthly spend scenarios (combined tokens billed at above unit price):
- 1.0B tokens/month -> 1,000 * $12.10 = $12,100 / month
- 1.2B tokens/month -> 1,200 * $12.10 = $14,520 / month
- 1.5B tokens/month -> 1,500 * $12.10 = $18,150 / month

A few clarifying points:
- If you sign a reserved commitment (6–12 months), we can move hosted list price down and reflect that in the private-offer (example: hosted $9.50 -> AWS PO ~$10.45 / 1M). I can model committed tiers if you share target commitment length and minimum monthly token guarantee.
- Marketplace uplifts are negotiable; the private-offer paperwork can show an explicit seller margin so procurement can validate.
- For procurement fields: typical required fields are seller legal name, Redwood tax ID, marketplace account ID, SKU/line item description, unit price (USD), term, and billing contact. We can fill the CM-PO-Template.pdf and return a completed version.

Next steps (concrete):
1) You confirm AWS as final marketplace.
2) Procurement sends the filled PO template or gives the go-ahead to us filling it.
3) We prepare a one-page pricing insert + DocuSign SOW and the private-offer request to AWS.

I've attached redwood-marketplace-po-mapping.csv (compact copy of the mapping) and will prepare a committed-tier scenario if you want price breaks.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing call — private offers & unit economics for Clearmetrics

Sofia — looks good to me. Approve the AWS PO flow and the 10% uplift placeholder. Rafael, please loop in SE for final SKU wording (we want to avoid model-name ambiguity on the PO).

Marissa Cole
